angles.text: Can TurboQuant+-class KV quantization run inside llama.cpp on an 8 GB CUDA GPU or ggml-cpu, and what is the smallest measurable first step (one branch, one kernel, one benchmark line)?
What is the shortest measured path to serving Bonsai 2 27B ternary on this 8 GB box at a usable tokens/s (serve line, kernel, MTP/spec-decode), and what does it displace in the current preset list?
Is runtime behavioral ablation (OrcaBonsai) a 0-USD lever the town can use on its local parents/kids, and what one experiment would prove or kill it?
